results.question: Which store had the highest total sales revenue? Just give me the top one.
results.sql:
=== Data Query ===
SELECT TOP (1)
       l.store_name AS store_name,
       SUM(s.total_revenue) AS total_sales_revenue
FROM TS.sales AS s
INNER JOIN TS.location_master AS l
    ON l.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY l.store_name
ORDER BY SUM(s.total_revenue) DESC;
results.answer: Southpoint Center had the highest total sales revenue: $414.93 million.

results.question: Which store has the highest average daily foot traffic?
results.sql:
=== Data Query ===
SELECT TOP (1)
    lm.store_id,
    lm.store_name,
    lm.city,
    lm.state,
    CAST(AVG(CAST(st.foot_traffic_count AS decimal(18,2))) AS decimal(18,2)) AS average_daily_foot_traffic,
    COUNT(*) AS days_recorded
FROM TS.store_traffic AS st
INNER JOIN TS.location_master AS lm
    ON lm.store_id = st.store_id
GROUP BY lm.store_id, lm.store_name, lm.city, lm.state
ORDER BY AVG(CAST(st.foot_traffic_count AS decimal(18,2))) DESC;
results.answer: Uptown Gallery (S008) in San Diego, CA has the highest average daily foot traffic: 630.32 visitors per recorded day, based on 31 days of data.

results.question: Which employee made the most sales by revenue?
results.sql:
=== Data Query ===
SELECT TOP (1)
    e.employee_name AS employee_name,
    s.employee_id AS employee_id,
    SUM(s.total_revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM TS.sales AS s
INNER JOIN TS.employee_data AS e
    ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id
GROUP BY e.employee_name, s.employee_id
ORDER BY SUM(s.total_revenue) DESC;
results.answer: William Sanchez (E0022) made the most sales by revenue, generating $71.39 million in total revenue across the available sales data.
